named_events.impact_description: Created an overnight profitability challenge and led to reserve strengthening / repricing across the motor portfolio

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were GBP 713.183m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded a net prior-year release of GBP 9.56m (approximately 1.3% of opening gross reserves). The published movement is driven by releases in the risk margin and loss adjustment expense reserves and overall favorable claims development, although the report also highlights the significant market impact of the Ogden discount rate change which affected reserving assumptions and pricing across the motor portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: Ogden discount rate announcement on 27 February 2017.
reserve strengthening for the impact of the change in Ogden discount rates.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure used is the published total (GBP 9.56m) from the 'Movement in prior accident year's provision for claims outstanding' note. That note presents aggregate (net) movements (labelled 'Net claims (strengthening)/release' and subsequent 'risk margin' and 'loss adjustment' releases). A gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement amount is not separately provided in that movement note; therefore the NET figure has been used as fallback and flagged. RITC / TPRe reinsurance arrangements are present in the report and may distort development patterns; users should consult the gross claims development triangle (present) for detailed vintage analysis.
